title: Floating point exception in group_norm

labels.name: module: error checking
labels.description: Bugs related to incorrect/lacking error checking

labels.name: triaged
labels.description: This issue has been looked at a team member, and triaged and prioritized into an appropriate module

body:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

Floating point exception in `group_norm` when `num_groups` is 0.

### Example to reproduce

```python
import torch

input = torch.full((4, 6, 5,), 1, dtype=torch.float32, requires_grad=False)
num_groups = 0
weight = torch.full((4, 6, 5,), 1, dtype=torch.float32, requires_grad=False)
bias = torch.full((4, 6, 5,), 1, dtype=torch.float32, requires_grad=False)
eps = 0
cudnn_enabled = False
torch.group_norm(input, num_groups, weight, bias, eps, cudnn_enabled)
```

### Result
```floating point exception```

### Expected behavior
Graceful termination or a RuntimeError to be thrown.

### Note
This bug was discovered using fuzz testing.
